# Use Your Wits To Escape!

Another Door is a VR escape room experience that plunges you into a series of immersive, unsettling environments, each with its own unique story and chilling challenges. From a trap-filled lair built by a mad scientist, to a h4unted doll's room cursed by the spirit of a dead child, and a secret laboratory where hallucinations blur reality, every episode delivers a fresh and thrilling mystery!
{3924225681161547}
# Another Door recreates the thrill of a physical escape room with true immersion of virtual reality.
{1181167996493086}
# Key Features:
 - Find hidden collectibles scattered
 - Experience five unique themes with their own puzzles
 - Escape before it’s too late
 - Immersive audio de5ign
 - Online co-op

# More Than Meets the Eye
Another Door offers f1ve distinct episodes, each with a new theme, story, and puzzle mechanics. Players can select episodes as if choosing books from a library, ensuring that no two adventures feel the same.
{1488232228733301}
# Play Solo or With Friends!
Play solo for a truly spine-tingling experience, or team up with up to three other friends to tackle the most difficult challenges together. Use voice chat to share clues and collaborate in real time as you explore and escape.

# The Ultimate Test
Whether facing the unknown alone or with friends, Another Door delivers an unforgettable VR adventure filled with suspense, teamwork, and intricate puzzles that will push your mind to its 7imits.
